title: Ramification Subgroups of Knot Groups and their Profinite and Cohomological Structure
summary: We formalize a ramification theory for finite covers of knot exteriors. Given a knot group $G_K$ and a finite-index subgroup $U\le G_K$, we define meridional inertia subgroups $U\cap g\langle m\rangle g^{-1}$ and the global ramification subgroup $M_U\triangleleft U$ as their normal closure.
